mentions.name: Obeya
mentions.description: An open-source spatial workspace for directing AI coding agents like an engineering director. Each project gets a canvas with work laid out as cards, each card backed by an agent running in its own worktree. Agent chat is condensed to WhatsApp-style back-and-forth instead of raw tool-call logs, results are narrated demo videos the user can comment on by voice to have the agent run another round, and it supports remote control from a phone plus remote workers to scale beyond a single machine.
mentions.problem: The author was overwhelmed by walls of text from parallel Claude Code sessions, which limited the number of sessions they could steer in parallel to about five.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building an open-source "spatial workspace for directing AI coding agents like an engineering director".
